cadoran_4b.m: Head out of town to the north. There are two settlements there, Prim and Blackwater mountain Settlement. There has been a rockfall though, making it very difficult to get to them.
r: Thanks for the information. What was it you said about the monsters?

cadoren_0.m: Welcome to our wonderful Inn. How can we help you?

cadoren_1.m: My name is Cadoren. I'm the best cook in town.

cadoren_2.m: Unlike most, lesser, cooks in local towns, I'm a specialist.
r: Enough of the bragging. Show me what you have to trade.

cadoren_3.m: Food that lasts a long time. *cough*. Or in some cases food that has already lasted a long time.
r: That sounds interesting. Show me what you have.
Why do you need food that lasts a long time?

cadoren_4.m: The path to Blackwater mountain has been cut off. There are also increasing attacks by monsters. These things have driven down trade, making supplies hard to get.
r: So all the food you sell is old?
Thanks for the information. I have to leave now.

cadoren_4a.m: We think they came from Mount Galmore, and they recently started attacking the town. We can fight them off, but they deter travelers from coming here.
r: OK. Could you repeat what you said about that other mountain.

cadoren_5.m: Of course not. We have some fields where we grow crops. And we have a number of goats.

cadoren_6.m: Goats are very versatile. They eat almost anything, provide both milk and meat, and their hides make excellent clothing.

cadoren_7.m: With supplies from other towns being so limited, getting the goats was an excellent idea. My idea, of course.
r: *Sigh*. The whole town would obviously starve if it were not for you. Thanks for the information though.
How about you quit with the bragging, and show me what you have to trade.
Whatever. Why don't we go back to what you said about the monsters and that mountain.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
